name: Southern Score Builders Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司获得价值RM180,000,000的医院主楼工程合约，并完成收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将机械与电气工程纳入业务范围；同时终止与MCC Overseas及Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics的谅解备忘录。此外，公司对Nova Pharma Solutions发起无条件强制全面收购。
overview_en: In 2026, the Company secured a RM180,000,000 contract for main building works of a hospital and completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering, bringing mechanical and electrical works into its business scope; it also terminated the memorandum of understanding with MCC Overseas and Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics. In addition, the Company launched an unconditional mandatory take-over offer for Nova Pharma Solutions.

segments.name: 建筑管理服务
segments.note: 今年获得一项价值RM180,000,000的医院主楼工程合约。
segments.note_en: Secured a RM180,000,000 contract for main building works of a hospital this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Southern Score Sdn Bhd接受Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh的授标函，承接马六甲医院主楼工程，合约总值RM180,000,000（不含销售与服务税）。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Southern Score Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of award from Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh to undertake main building works for a hospital in Melaka, with a total contract sum of RM180,000,000 (excluding sales and service tax).

segments.name: 机械与电气工程
segments.note: 今年完成收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将机械与电气工程纳入业务。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering this year, bringing mechanical and electrical works into the business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订第二份补充协议，以现金RM22,950,000收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a second supplemental agreement to acquire a 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering for a cash consideration of RM22,950,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年终止一项机器人合作备忘录，并对Nova Pharma Solutions发起强制全面收购。
segments.note_en: Terminated a robotics collaboration memorandum of understanding and launched a mandatory general offer for Nova Pharma Solutions this year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 终止与MCC Overseas (M) Sdn Bhd及Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co. Ltd.的谅解备忘录，因合作缺乏实质进展。
actions.text_en: Terminated the memorandum of understanding with MCC Overseas (M) Sdn Bhd and Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co. Ltd. due to lack of material progress in the collaboration.

actions.title: OFFER DOCUMENT IN RELATION TO THE UNCONDITIONAL MANDATORY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY SOUTHERN SCORE BUILDERS BERHAD ("OFFEROR") THROUGH KENANGA INVE
actions.text: 对Nova Pharma Solutions Berhad发起无条件强制全面收购。
actions.text_en: Launched an unconditional mandatory take-over offer for Nova Pharma Solutions Berhad to acquire all remaining shares not already held at RM0.37 cash per offer share.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将机械与电气工程纳入业务范围。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering, mechanical and electrical works were brought into the business scope.
